exposure: Multidisciplinary cooperation model in obstetric care
outcome: Rate of postpartum hemorrhage in vaginal delivery
Rate of transfer to cesarean section
Incidence of 5-min Apgar score <=7 in full-term neonates
cohort: 3751 full-term pregnant women who underwent vaginal trial labor at Zibo Maternal and Child Health Hospital between July 2021 and June 2022
finding: The implementation of a multidisciplinary cooperation model in obstetric care was associated with an increased rate of labor analgesia and a decreased rate of postpartum hemorrhage, transfer to cesarean section, and incidence of low Apgar scores in newborns.
